lesson.friendly_owl.title: Friendly Owl
lesson.friendly_owl.summary: Build a warm little owl from an oval body, balanced eyes, curved wings, a beak and tiny feet.
lesson.friendly_owl.step.body: Draw one tall soft oval for the owl’s body.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.body.hint: Think of a big egg standing upright.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.body.visual: Here is the oval shape we are aiming for.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.body.anchors: Start at the top, travel down one side, around the bottom, and back up.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.body.trace: Follow the guide slowly from the top and keep the curve smooth.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.body.assist: I’ll keep the full oval guide visible while you finish it.
lesson.friendly_owl.complete.body: Great foundation. Your owl has a body.
lesson.friendly_owl.step.eyes: Add two round eyes side by side, then two small pupils.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.eyes.hint: Place the eyes like two coins sitting at the same height.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.eyes.visual: Use the two circles to check the spacing between the eyes.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.eyes.anchors: Aim for one eye on each side of the middle line.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.eyes.trace: Trace the eye guides if the spacing feels tricky.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.eyes.assist: Keep the eye guides on screen and copy one circle at a time.
lesson.friendly_owl.complete.eyes: Nice! Those balanced eyes give your owl personality.
lesson.friendly_owl.step.wings: Give your owl one curved wing on each side.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.wings.hint: Imagine two long leaves hugging the owl’s body.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.wings.visual: The wing curves sit at the same height on both sides.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.wings.anchors: Start near the shoulder and curve gently toward the belly.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.wings.trace: Trace each wing path, one side at a time.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.wings.assist: I’ll keep both wing paths visible while you finish.
lesson.friendly_owl.complete.wings: Lovely wings — your owl looks ready to perch.
lesson.friendly_owl.step.beak_and_feet: Finish with a tiny pointed beak and two simple feet.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.beak_and_feet.h: Keep the beak small between the eyes, then add two little feet below.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.beak_and_feet.v: Use the guide to see where the beak and feet belong.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.beak_and_feet.a: Make the beak with two short slanting lines, then split each foot into two toes.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.beak_and_feet.t: Trace the short detail lines if you want extra support.
lesson.friendly_owl.help.beak_and_feet.a: I’ll leave the detail guide visible so you can finish calmly.
lesson.friendly_owl.complete.beak_and_fe: Wonderful! Your friendly owl is complete.
